description: Search US business bankruptcy cases by debtor name. Individual debtors and adversary proceedings (lawsuits) are omitted unless include_individuals or include_adversary is true. Case numbers are shortCaseNumber. FREE (exact/prefix, no *): limited fields, no auth. Use *term for contains (paid). Optional court filter. total is the full match count; pass skip for the next page.

include_individuals.description: Include individual debtors. Default false (business filings only).

name: search_bankruptcy_cases_tool
